fields.title: Appendix — Cross-check of the 2026-11-09 viral post
fields.md:
| Claim | Verdict | Filing / primary source |
|---|---|---|
| Buffett: "a casino next to the church, and the church is empty" | Partly true, distorted | 2026-05-02 CNBC interview — he said the numbers grew at **both** the church and the casino. He called one-day options 'gambling' ([CNBC transcript](https://pressroom.versantmedia.com/cnbc/press-releases/cnbc-transcript-berkshire-hathaway-chairman-warren-buffett-sits-down-cnbcs), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/05/02/warren-buffett-investing-gambling-mood-one-day-options-prediction-markets-betting-berkshire-hathaway/)) |
| Buffett Indicator 234.3%, average 165% | Partly true | 234.3% is the GuruFocus value of 2026-07-21; currently 220–244% depending on the measurement method. The 165% average cannot be verified ([GuruFocus](https://www.gurufocus.com/stock-market-valuations.php)) |
| CAPE 41.9, 2nd highest ever | Partly true (old value) | Currently 38.91 (2026-11-06), peak 44.19 (1999-12), average 17.45 ([multpl](https://www.multpl.com/shiller-pe)) |
| 14 straight quarters of net selling, hoarding cash | Incorrect | Ended with net buying in 2Q26; 3Q26 share repurchases of $9.65 billion (this report 1-3, 1-4) |
| Four Big Tech companies' net income $400 billion+ | True (understated) | Sum of the last four quarters about $700 billion (sum of each company's IR, estimate) |
